# phasetwo_cluster (Resource)

A dedicated Phase Two Keycloak cluster.

Creating a cluster charges the organization's payment method and provisions real infrastructure, which usually takes several minutes.

~> **Destroying a cluster does not remove it immediately.** Unless it never completed billing setup, the cluster moves to `PENDING_DELETION` and is torn down at the end of the current billing cycle. It continues to bill until then, and its name stays taken — a later cluster cannot reuse it.

~> Nothing about a cluster can be changed in place. Every argument forces replacement, which means destroying the existing cluster and all realms on it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phasetwo_organization" "team" {
  name = "acme"
}

# Payment methods are added in the Phase Two console, not by Terraform.
data "phasetwo_payment_method" "default" {
  organization_id = data.phasetwo_organization.team.id
  default         = true
}

resource "phasetwo_cluster" "main" {
  name              = "acme-prod"
  region            = "US_EAST_1"
  tier              = "premium"
  billing_period    = "annual"
  organization_id   = data.phasetwo_organization.team.id
  payment_method_id = data.phasetwo_payment_method.default.id

  timeouts = {
    create = "60m"
  }
}

output "cluster_host" {
  value = phasetwo_cluster.main.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Cluster name, unique across Phase Two. Becomes part of the cluster's default hostname.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization (team) that will own and be billed for the cluster. Organizations are not managed by this provider — look one up with the `phasetwo_organization` data source.
- `payment_method_id` (String) ID of a saved payment method on the organization, which is charged for the cluster. Payment methods are not managed by this provider — look one up with the `phasetwo_payment_method` data source.

The API treats this as optional, but omitting it returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in a browser, which Terraform cannot complete. It is therefore required here.
- `region` (String) AWS region to provision into, e.g. `US_EAST_1`.

### Optional

- `billing_period` (String) Billing period: `monthly` (the default) or `annual`.
- `domain` (String) Custom domain to record at provision time. This is not the live hostname — to serve the cluster on a custom domain, add a `phasetwo_cluster_domain` and then point `phasetwo_cluster_primary_host` at it.
- `tier` (String) Subscription tier, which sets the cluster's resource limits. One of `starter`, `premium`, `enterprise`. Defaults to `starter`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the cluster was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `host` (String) Base URL of the cluster's Keycloak instance.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the cluster.
- `owner` (String) ID of the organization that owns the cluster.
- `resource_limits` (String) `standard`, or `custom` when the cluster has been exempted from its tier's count limits.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle state. `ACTIVE` once provisioned; `PENDING_DELETION` and `ARCHIVED` are terminal.
- `variant` (String) `DEDICATED` when the cluster has an owning organization.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import phasetwo_cluster.main 4f8c1e2a-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
